retry_comparison.limit: Reported usage remains distinct from charged totals, which include labelled conservative estimates for unknown refusal usage. Internal failed-attempt tokens and unreported non-refusal failure tokens remain unknown. Observed HTTP attempts and retry logs measure incidence, not omitted tokens. Credential-opaque per-attempt and failed-call usage receipts remain required before the full matrix.

spend.usage_limit: Charged totals include reported usage plus explicitly labelled conservative estimates from the ledger; reported usage is never replaced with estimates. Internal failed-attempt usage remains unknown. Totals exclude undecodable journal tails and absent records; input hashes and issues retain that boundary. Completed evaluation spans are reconstructed in order, not independently timestamped.
